_meta.purpose: Override the Product column with an English title per SKU. Loaded at runtime by streamlit_app.py:load_data() and applied to every row whose SKU appears as a key here. Anything not listed keeps the title Novadata's export carries (which may be German / Italian / Spanish / French / Dutch depending on the listing's primary marketplace).
_meta.how_to_add: Open this file and append entries to the 'titles' object. The key is the SKU code as it appears in the dashboard; the value is the English product name to display. Push the change and the dashboard picks it up on the next reboot.
